name: Haitatsu Sareru Koneko-tachi
source:
Everything unfolded with an ad in a gossip newspaper. "Cat for sale", no more details were provided, but I sensed something not usual in it. It's not just an ad for a pet shop. Because I knew that there are sub-human people called "cats" who are traded in the black market, I got some. The cats are superbly hot as much as I expected.......

[Edited From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ015221.html/?locale=en_US]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
一切都随着八卦报纸上的一则广告展开。“待售的猫”，没有提供更多细节，但我感​​觉到其中有一些不寻常的东西。这不仅仅是宠物店的广告。因为我知道有一些被称为“猫”的亚人类在黑市上进行交易，所以我得到了一些。猫们和我想象的一样非常热……
